proposed.title: Daredevil S1#12
proposed.text: Ellison refuses to run Ben's story on Fisk, and when Ben asks how much Fisk is paying him, Ellison fires him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Ben's editor and old friend, who fires him over the Fisk story.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Ellison's veteran reporter and old friend, whom he fires.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S1#12: Ellison reads Ben's Fisk expose and refuses to run it; Ben calls him a sell-out and asks how much Fisk pays him, and Ellison fires him on the spot. A clear falling-out with no stage.

proposed.title: Daredevil S1#8
proposed.text: As the masked vigilante, Matt confronts Ben at his car, denies bombing the Russians and gives him Wilson Fisk's name to expose.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The masked vigilante who gives Ben Fisk's name.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A veteran reporter Matt, in his mask, asks to expose Fisk.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S1#8: the masked Matt meets Ben face to face at his car and tells him Fisk is behind the crime rings so Ben can expose him; Ben writes the story before Fisk goes public. They meet unmasked only in S1#9, so the tie starts one title earlier.

now.title: The Punisher S2#1
now.text: Beth Quinn is a bartender who has a one-night stand with Frank and then becomes his friend.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A man Beth sleeps with once, who becomes her friend.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A bartender Frank sleeps with once, then befriends.

proposed.text: Beth Quinn is a bartender who spends the night with Frank. When he comes back to her bar the next night, she is shot in his fight with the people hunting a teenage girl, and he rushes her to the hospital.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A man Beth sleeps with, whose fight at her bar gets her shot.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A bartender Frank sleeps with, shot in his fight at her bar.

changes.evidence: The Punisher S2#1: Beth and Frank sleep together and have breakfast with her son; he returns that night, fights the girl's pursuers in the bar, Beth is shot and Frank races her to hospital. She never becomes his friend on screen (she appears only in S2#1-2 and gives his name to Pilgrim in S2#2), so 'then becomes his friend' is unsupported and the defining event is missing.

proposed.title: Iron Fist S2#10
proposed.text: Ward learns Bethany is pregnant with his child and promises to be there, but she ends things, saying she cannot take care of a third person.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Bethany's lover and the father of her baby, whom she leaves.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Ward's sponsor and lover, pregnant with his child. She ends it.

changes.evidence: Iron Fist S2#10: after Ward overhears her share at a meeting that she is pregnant, Bethany confirms the baby is his, turns down his promise to be there, kisses him and says goodbye. The romance ends with no stage.

proposed.title: The Punisher S1#10
proposed.text: Detective Brett Mahoney questions Billy Russo after Lewis Wilson's attack on Senator Ori's fundraiser, pressing him on his ties to both Wilson and Frank.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The detective who questions Billy after the attack on Ori.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Anvil's chief, whom Mahoney questions after the attack on Ori.

changes.evidence: The Punisher S1#10: Mahoney interrogates Russo at the hotel about Wilson breaching Anvil's security and calls it a big coincidence that Russo knew Wilson and served with Castle; Russo walks out. They meet well before the S2#3 stage.

proposed.title: The Punisher S1#3
proposed.text: Billy Russo and Curtis Hoyle, friends from the war, drink at Frank's grave on his birthday, and Billy's money keeps Curtis's support group running.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Billy's friend from the war, whose support group Billy funds.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Curtis's war buddy, who funds his support group.

changes.evidence: The Punisher S1#3: Billy visits Curtis at the church with a check for the group's rent, and the two visit Castle's grave for his birthday. Their friendship is on screen ten episodes before the only stage (S1#13), which says Billy 'was' his friend.

proposed.title: The Punisher S2#13
proposed.text: Dying from Madani's bullets, Billy calls Curtis for help and asks not to die alone. Curtis sends Frank to him instead, and Frank kills him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Billy's friend from the war, who sends Frank to him as he dies.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Curtis's old war buddy, whom he leaves to Frank.

changes.evidence: The Punisher S2#13: Russo phones Hoyle from the church asking for help; Hoyle stays silent, then tells Castle where Russo is, and Castle kills him. Also S2#6 Russo corners Hoyle and apologizes. The end of their story has no stage.

proposed.title: The Punisher S2#13
proposed.text: When Billy finds Krista hurt and attacks Madani, she shoots him three times, wounds that leave him dying.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The agent who shoots Billy three times, leaving him dying.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The man who shot Madani in the head, whom she shoots three times.

changes.evidence: The Punisher S2#12-13: Russo finds Dumont below her window and Madani inside; he attacks her and she shoots him three times before he knocks her out. He bleeds out and Castle finishes him. Their final clash has no stage.

proposed.title: The Punisher S2#2
proposed.text: Krista Dumont is Billy Russo's therapist at the hospital, helping him piece together the memories he lost.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Billy's therapist, who helps him piece his memory together.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Krista's patient, who has lost his memory.

changes.evidence: The Punisher S2#2: Russo, claiming amnesia, works with therapist Dumont to organize the 'jigsaw puzzle' of his mind; in S2#3 he takes her hostage to escape and in S2#4 he comes to her apartment. The tie starts four episodes before the S2#6 stage. Kind for a therapist is a judgment call (ally or mentor).

proposed.title: The Punisher S2#12
proposed.text: Billy gets fake passports so he and Krista can start a new life together, but finds her badly hurt after Madani pushes her out of her window.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Billy's therapist and lover, badly hurt before they can run away.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Krista's patient and lover, who plans to flee with her.

changes.evidence: The Punisher S2#12: Russo buys fake passports for himself and Dumont; Madani fights Dumont and pushes her out a window, and Russo finds her seriously injured outside. Their plans end here (he dies in S2#13).

proposed.title: The Punisher S1#12
proposed.text: When Rawlins keeps torturing Frank and tries to cut out his eye, Billy cuts Frank loose, and Frank kills Rawlins.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Billy's Cerberus commander, whom Billy turns on and leaves to Frank.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Rawlins's soldier, who turns on him and frees Frank to kill him.

changes.evidence: The Punisher S1#12: Russo promised Castle a quick death, but Rawlins sadistically tortures him and tries to cut out his eye; Russo helps Castle get free and Castle kills Rawlins. Also S1#11 Rawlins offers Russo up as the CIA's scapegoat. Billy's betrayal of Rawlins has no stage.

proposed.title: Daredevil S2#2
proposed.text: Blake Tower, a prosecutor under DA Reyes, presses Foggy to let the DA's office deal with his client Grotto directly, then uses Grotto as bait for the Punisher.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A defense lawyer Tower faces over Grotto's witness deal.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A prosecutor Foggy faces over Grotto's witness deal.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S2#2: Reyes and Tower meet Grotto, Foggy and Karen at the precinct and try to strong-arm Foggy; the wire deal turns out to be a trap for the Punisher. They clash again in S2#5 (Tower asks Foggy for Grotto's files) and at Castle's trial (S2#7-8). The connection starts here, not in S3#4.

proposed.title: Daredevil S3#12
proposed.text: Foggy offers to drop out of the race if Tower will hear Ray Nadeem's testimony against Fisk, and Tower agrees and convenes a grand jury.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A rival for DA who drops out to bring Tower a witness against Fisk.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The DA Foggy runs against, then works with against Fisk.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S3#12: Mahoney pulls Tower over so Foggy can offer to quit the race in exchange for an hour; Tower takes Nadeem's testimony and convenes a grand jury. In S3#13 Foggy endorses Tower and they shake hands, ending the rivalry. The turn has no stage.

now.title: Daredevil S2#2
now.text: Blake Tower is a Manhattan prosecutor under District Attorney Reyes, sometimes opposing Matt's firm and sometimes working with it.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A lawyer whose firm Tower sometimes opposes, sometimes helps.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A prosecutor who sometimes opposes and sometimes helps Matt.

changes.evidence: Matt is not at the S2#2 precinct meeting (Foggy and Karen deal with Reyes and Tower while Matt recovers and goes out as Daredevil), and Tower is not in S2#6. Tower first faces Matt in court at Frank Castle's trial, S2#7-8.

now.title: Luke Cage S1#11
now.text: After Reyes's death, Tower succeeds her as District Attorney.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Tower's late boss, the DA he succeeds.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A prosecutor under Reyes, who succeeds her as DA.

changes.evidence: Reyes is shot dead in Daredevil S2#10 (stage 1). In Luke Cage S1#11 Tower simply appears as the new DA; nothing happens between him and Reyes there, so the stage describes Tower alone, not the two of them.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#15
proposed.text: Bobbi turns out to be a mole for Robert Gonzales' rival S.H.I.E.L.D. She steals Fury's toolbox from Coulson's office and helps Gonzales' agents seize his base.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The director Bobbi spies on and betrays for Gonzales.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's agent, who betrays him for Gonzales.

changes.evidence: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#15: Morse sabotages the Playground, steals the toolbox from Coulson's desk and fights May; Gonzales takes the base. S2#18 Bobbi and Mack take Coulson's surrender. A clear betrayal after the S2#5 stage (same season, so the focus did not list it).

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#20
proposed.text: After Coulson's hidden helicarrier saves lives in Sokovia, Bobbi defends him to Gonzales' board, and the two sides merge with Coulson as Director.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The director Bobbi betrays, then backs again.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's agent, who betrays him, then backs him again.

changes.evidence: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#20: the board is grateful after Sokovia; Morse defends Coulson to Weaver and the factions merge with Coulson remaining Director. The reconciliation has no stage.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#13
proposed.text: Arrested after a mission in Siberia, Bobbi turns down Coulson's offer to break her out and lets herself be disavowed to protect S.H.I.E.L.D., leaving the agency for good.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The director Bobbi leaves S.H.I.E.L.D. to protect.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's agent, who leaves S.H.I.E.L.D. to protect it.

changes.evidence: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#13: Coulson comes to the Interpol facility offering an EMP escape; Morse and Hunter refuse, accept being disavowed and leave S.H.I.E.L.D., and the team bids them a silent farewell at a bar.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#6
proposed.text: May tests whether Bobbi is ready for the field, then takes her after Ward and tells her she scouted Bobbi at the Academy.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who scouted Bobbi at the Academy and tests her return to the field.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: May's friend, whom she scouted at the Academy.

changes.evidence: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#6: May attacks Bobbi as a readiness test, takes her on the Strucker/Ward hunt in the Caymans and Lisbon, and reveals she scouted her at the Academy. After the S2#15 fight this is their reconciliation in the field.

proposed.title: Luke Cage S2#4
proposed.text: Bobby tells Luke he is moving to San Diego to give his sick daughter a kidney, and the two say goodbye at the barbershop.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A loyal friend from Pop's, whom Bobby leaves to help his daughter.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A loyal friend from Pop's, who leaves Harlem for his daughter.

changes.evidence: Luke Cage S2#4: Bobby learns he is a donor match for his estranged daughter, tells Luke he is moving to San Diego, and they reminisce about Pop and hug before Bobby leaves Harlem.

proposed.title: The Punisher S2#8
proposed.text: When Mahoney corners Frank in an alley, Curtis fires a shot inches from Mahoney's head and makes him drop his gun so Frank can get away.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A man who fires a warning shot at Mahoney to free Frank.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A cop Curtis fires a warning shot at to free Frank.

changes.evidence: The Punisher S2#8: after the ReadyQuick robbery Mahoney holds Castle at gunpoint; Hoyle fires a rifle shot near his head and orders him to drop his gun, and they escape. The S2#13 stage refers back to this, but the meeting itself has no stage.

proposed.title: The Punisher S2#13
proposed.text: After Madani survives her fight with Russo, Mahoney says he will stop going after her and hands back her badge, then reluctantly goes along with her account of Russo's death.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An agent Mahoney butts heads with, then makes peace with.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A detective Madani butts heads with, then makes peace with.

changes.evidence: The Punisher S2#13: at Dumont's apartment Mahoney promises he will not target Madani any more and offers back her badge and gun; at the church he reluctantly accepts the story that leaves Castle out. Their rivalry ends here.

now.title: Daredevil S2#1
now.text: Sergeant Brett Mahoney hunts Frank Castle, the Punisher, for his killings across the city.
now.on_a_card_about_b: A vigilante Mahoney hunts for his killings.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A police sergeant who hunts Frank for his killings.

proposed.title: Daredevil S2#4
proposed.text: Sergeant Brett Mahoney takes Frank Castle, the Punisher, into custody for his killings across the city.

changes.evidence: In Daredevil S2#1-3 Mahoney only works the crime scenes of an unknown shooter and never meets Frank. They first meet in S2#4, when Daredevil leaves Castle for Mahoney to arrest and take the credit; in S2#8 of The Punisher Mahoney recalls this as their last encounter.

proposed.title: Daredevil S3#13
proposed.text: Mahoney arrests Fisk again at the Presidential Hotel and refuses to let him say goodbye to Vanessa, asking whether Nadeem got to say goodbye to his wife.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The kingpin Mahoney arrests, twice.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The cop who arrests Fisk, twice.

changes.evidence: Daredevil S3#13: after Nadeem's dying declaration leaks, Mahoney storms Fisk's suite, arrests him and Vanessa, and denies Fisk's plea for a goodbye with that line about Nadeem.

now.title: Daredevil S2#2
now.text: Mahoney passes on Clemons's old advice to keep witnesses in the dark.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Mahoney's senior colleague, whom Kilgrave forces him to hold at gunpoint.
now.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow detective who turns his gun on Clemons under Kilgrave.

changes.evidence: Clemons is killed by Will Simpson in Jessica Jones S1 (corpse in S1#11); in Daredevil S2#2 Clemons is only quoted by Mahoney (Clemons is 'mentioned' there). A remembered piece of advice is not an event between the two.

owner_calls.question: Beth and Frank have one night together (plus his return the next night, when she is shot). The owner's rule says a brief fling doesn't make partners. Which kind should this one-stage connection have?
owner_calls.evidence: The Punisher S2#1: one night and breakfast, then she is shot in his fight; S2#2 she gives his alias to Pilgrim. No further contact on screen.
